triggers.mandatory_call: mandatory (once the project is outside every Div C 2.4.1.1.(1) exception); plus a separate discretionary AHJ power in Div C 2.4.1.1.(4)
triggers.call_basis: Div C 2.4.1.1.(3) and 2.4.2.2.(1) use "shall"; Subsection 2.4.2. applies to every 2.4.1.1.(3) project (Div C 2.4.2.1.(1)). Div C 2.4.1.1.(4) is "may require" (discretionary).

basis.quote: For buildings other than those described in Sentence (1), the drawings and specifications shall be authenticated by one or more registered professionals
This Subsection applies to a project that falls within the scope of Sentence 2.4.1.1.(3).
Before applying for a permit, the owner shall a) retain a coordinating registered professional
c) provide the authority having jurisdiction with Schedules A and B
b) classified as a residential occupancy that is i) a single-family dwelling, or ii) a multiple-family dwelling that contains 4 dwelling units or less
the authority having jurisdiction may require the involvement of one or more registered professionals

triggers.name: Part 9 sends sheathing fastening, anchorage or lumber roof sheathing to Part 4 because of wind or seismic hazard
triggers.call_basis: The Part 9 Sentences say "shall conform to Part 4" / "shall be designed according to Part 4"; Div C 2.4.1.2.(1) then says the Part 4 designer "shall be a registered professional".

basis.quote: Fastening of sheathing shall conform to Part 4, a) where the 1-in-50 hourly wind pressure is equal to or greater than 1.2 kPa
Where … Sa(0.2), is greater than 1.8 or … wind pressure is equal to or greater than 1.2 kPa, anchorage shall be designed according to Part 4.
Lumber roof sheathing shall be designed according to Part 4, where a) the seismic spectral acceleration, Sa(0.2), is greater than 1.2
For design carried out in accordance with Part 4 … the designer shall be a registered professional skilled in the work concerned.

fires_when: 1-in-50 hourly wind pressure >= 1.2 kPa (sheathing fastening, anchorage; lumber roof sheathing at >= 1.20 kPa)
Sa(0.2) > 1.8 (anchorage; fastening of required braced wall panels)

Edmonton: 1-in-50 0.45 kPa (Table C-2, page 667 of the PDF), Sa(0.2) 0.103 (Table C-3, page 672 of the PDF)

input_facts.climate_source: synthetic boundary value (no Table C-2 Alberta row reaches it)

basis.quote: Except as provided in Sentence (4), reinforced concrete shall be designed to conform to the requirements of Part 4.
For flat insulating concrete form walls not exceeding 2 storeys in building height and having a maximum floor to floor height of 3 m

triggers.name: Any variance (alternative solution) request goes to a safety codes officer or Administrator
triggers.mandatory_call: discretionary decision; routing is required (only an Administrator or safety codes officer holds the power)
triggers.call_basis: SCA s.38(1) "may issue" and "is of the opinion": the grant is discretionary. The power is given only to "An Administrator or a safety codes officer", so the app can only route. s.38(3) "shall notify" binds the officer after issuing, not the applicant. This is officer routing, not professional design.

basis.source: Safety Codes Act, RSA 2000 c S-1 (King's Printer, current as of December 1, 2025)
basis.quote: An Administrator or a safety codes officer may issue a written variance
basis.verification: source-PDF-checked (pdftotext), page 31 of the Act PDF; not codedb (legislation)

basis.source: Safety Codes Act, RSA 2000 c S-1 (King's Printer, current as of December 1, 2025)
basis.quote: if the Administrator or officer is of the opinion that the variance provides approximately equivalent or greater safety performance
basis.verification: source-PDF-checked (pdftotext), page 31 of the Act PDF; not codedb (legislation)

basis.source: Safety Codes Act, RSA 2000 c S-1 (King's Printer, current as of December 1, 2025)
basis.quote: A safety codes officer on issuing a variance shall notify an Administrator.

basis.quote: b) using alternative solutions that will achieve at least the minimum level of performance required by Division B
